sessionInsights.metric.activeTime.how: The gaps between consecutive entries added up, counting only gaps shorter than 5 minutes; longer pauses count as idle.
sessionInsights.metric.alignment.how: Calls aligned turn pair by turn pair by a weighted LCS over their activity classes; the same action shares objects (files, line ranges, identifiers) of the arguments.
sessionInsights.metric.cacheMisses.how: A heuristic: a model call with at least 4,096 tokens of context that read under half of the smaller of its own and the previous call's context from cache. Only models that read from cache at least once count.
sessionInsights.metric.cacheShare.how: Cache reads over all request tokens (input + cache read + cache write) of the session's model calls, as pi recorded them.
sessionInsights.metric.callCost.how: Each model call's recorded cost (usage.cost.total) and tokens; never price × tokens.
sessionInsights.metric.contextCompositio: An estimate: pi's own rule of four characters a token (an image as 4,800 characters) over the request each call sent — system prompt sections, tool schemas, the latest compaction summary and its kept messages, replies (their recorded output tokens), tool results — replayed from the session file the way pi builds a request, then scaled so the parts sum to pi's exact total (input + cache read + cache write).
sessionInsights.metric.contextTokens.how: The request's context as pi recorded it: input plus cache-read plus cache-write tokens of the model call.
sessionInsights.metric.contextWindow.how: The model's context window from ThinkRail's model catalog. When the catalog has none, or a smaller one than this session used, the largest context the session observed is shown instead.
sessionInsights.metric.cost.how: pi's recorded cost total over every entry that carries usage, on every branch — the cost pi reports for this session.
sessionInsights.metric.costMoment.how: A moment is a run of consecutive calls of one plan step (or of one turn when there is no plan); a new turn or a compaction starts a new one. Its value is the sum of its calls' recorded cost, or tokens when the model records $0.
sessionInsights.metric.dailySpend.how: pi's recorded spend of every spend-bearing entry, every branch, by the host-local day of its timestamp: model calls by their model, pi's mirror of subagent spend, summaries and other usage. Subagent spend outside pi's total comes from the subagents' transcripts, on the day each ran.
sessionInsights.metric.errors.how: Tool results marked as errors plus model calls that stopped with an error or were aborted.
sessionInsights.metric.fileLines.how: From the tool calls: lines an edit's patch added and removed, and a write's content lines as added. Not a snapshot of the file.
sessionInsights.metric.fileReceipt.how: ThinkRail's turn receipts: the worktree snapshotted before and after each run, so this includes shell writes and formatters, and anything else that changed the worktree during the run.
sessionInsights.metric.fileTouches.how: Counted from the read, edit and write calls and their results; shell writes, formatters and generators are not seen.
sessionInsights.metric.finding.how: A deterministic rule over the sessions' recorded facts; rates carry a 95% Wilson interval and heuristics are labelled.
sessionInsights.metric.hotspots.how: Successful read, edit and write calls by workspace-relative path, summed across sessions; lines from the edit patches and the written content (from tool calls).
sessionInsights.metric.llmCalls.how: Model calls (assistant messages) on the active branch.
sessionInsights.metric.missCause.how: A heuristic: what changed between the missed call and the previous one, read from the session file — the model, a model re-selection, system prompt sections, the tool set, a compaction or context edit, the thinking level, or a pause over the cache's 5-minute TTL. A miss with none of these is not explainable from the data.
sessionInsights.metric.modelLatency.how: The median of pi's durationMs on model replies, where it was recorded.
sessionInsights.metric.plan.how: Rebuilt from the session's pi-todos calls: todo_write replaces the plan (steps it leaves out count as removed), todo_add / todo_update / todo_promote / todo_remove change one step, todo_list reads it. A step's calls, failures and spend are those made while it was in progress. Edits you make in the TODO panel are not in the session file; they show up only when the agent next lists the plan, at that time.
sessionInsights.metric.recovery.how: A heuristic. A retry is the same tool within the next 4 calls of the same turn, with the same path or at least half the words of its main argument. A chain ends recovered when an attempt succeeds, gave up when its last retry still failed, changed approach when nothing was retried. Model errors recover at the next successful model call, with the same model or after a switch.
sessionInsights.metric.sequences.how: Each session's own tool calls in issue order, mapped to activities (shell commands by their head); a transition is a call and the next one; subagent calls are not included.
sessionInsights.metric.skillListing.how: A skill's entry in the persisted available_skills list at pi's four characters a token: an estimate of what the list costs with every request.
sessionInsights.metric.skills.how: A skill activates on a successful read of its SKILL.md or a /skill:name prompt. Its scope is a heuristic: from the activation to the end of that turn, or to the next skill activated in the same turn.
sessionInsights.metric.sliceCompare.how: Per-session values from pi's recorded figures; the slice's median (a mean for retries, the ratio of the sums for the failure share) and a 95% bootstrap interval over sessions with a fixed seed.
sessionInsights.metric.start.how: When the session's first entry was written.
sessionInsights.metric.subagentRoles.how: Runs of the Agent tool by subagent_type, with each run's status and its final reported usage.
sessionInsights.metric.subagentRun.how: From the Agent call and its result in the parent session and the subagent's own transcript. The rationale is a quote of the parent's words right before the spawn, not an inference; the parent read the result in its next model call after the result arrived.
sessionInsights.metric.subagents.how: Subagents this session started, joined from their tool results, completion messages, usage entries and transcripts.
Spend of subagents recorded in their transcripts or final results but missing from pi's total. Shown on its own line, never added to it.
sessionInsights.metric.tokens.how: pi's recorded token total — input, output, cache reads and cache writes of every entry that carries usage, on every branch.
sessionInsights.metric.toolCalls.how: Tool calls in the session's assistant messages, on every branch.
sessionInsights.metric.toolDuration.how: From pi's durationMs on tool results, where it was recorded; calls without it are left out.
sessionInsights.metric.toolErrors.how: Tool results marked as errors, and their share of all tool calls.
sessionInsights.metric.toolStats.how: Counted from the tool calls of the main sessions and their results' isError; a shell command is keyed by its head (bun test, git diff). Error rates carry a 95% Wilson interval.
sessionInsights.metric.turnDuration.how: From what started the turn to the end of its last call, from entry timestamps and pi's durations.
sessionInsights.metric.turns.how: Turns started by your prompts, or by a background command's or subagent's completion that woke the idle agent.
sessionInsights.metric.userWait.how: Time inside the turn while an ask_user_question call was open — the agent was waiting for your answer.
sessionInsights.metric.waits.how: A heuristic: at every moment the session waits on one actor — an open question to you, a tool, the model, a subagent — and a pause belongs to what ended it: your prompt, a background completion, or nobody.
sessionInsights.metric.wallTime.how: From the session's first entry to its last.
sessionInsights.metric.warmCaches.how: A heuristic: a session's prompt cache counts as warm for the cache TTL after each model reply.
